prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [choose_path, layout] Story Screen Split Card Layout: Reframe the initial story screen layout into a clean split card structure separating pet lore from path options.
   config: {"story": {"layout": "split", "headline": "Welcome to Your Desktop Pet Companion"}}
1: [sign_in, hint] Sign In Multi Device Account Warning Hint: Display an explicit hint on the sign-in screen reassuring returning users that signing in restores existing pets.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Signing into your existing account automatically syncs and protects your adopted pets."}}
2: [adoption, new_screen] Custom Pet Photo Preview Confirmation Screen: Insert a photo confirmation step after photo upload where users inspect image framing before starting pet creation.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "new_photo_review", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "upload_photos": {"button_label": "Review Photos"}}
3: [adoption, wait_info] Adoption Certificate Naming Inspiration Carousel: Add a carousel of popular pet names and personality ideas directly onto the adoption certificate screen.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"components": [{"type": "tip_carousel", "text": "Need name ideas? Try classic names like Barnaby, Ziggy, or Mochi!"}]}}
4: [home, wait_info] Desktop Pet Launch Status Notification Toast: Show estimated waiting time and ready notifications on the waiting screen while pet assets initialize in the background.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_time_estimate": true, "notify_when_ready": true, "headline": "Preparing Your Pet Desktop Companion"}}
5: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Control Cheat Sheet Onboarding Sub-Flow: Add a brief walkthrough sub-flow explaining how to drag, talk to, and minimize the pet from the system tray.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro", "new_controls_walkthrough"], "home_intro": {"button_label": "Start Quick Controls Tour"}}
6: [finish, redesign] Home Intro Card Spotlight Layout Redesign: Redesign the home intro screen into a spotlight card highlighting primary pet interactions.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "spotlight", "headline": "Meet Your New Desktop Companion", "body": "Your pet is active on your desktop! Use the system tray icon anytime to adjust pet visibility or open controls."}}
7: [choose_path, incentive] Pick Path Welcome Sound Effect Greeting: Play a welcoming sound effect and render a friendly mascot greeting component on the initial story screen.
   config: {"story": {"components": [{"type": "sound", "asset": "asset:welcome_chime"}, {"type": "mascot", "style": "playful", "text": "Hello! Choose how you would like to meet your pet."}]}}
8: [sign_in, reorder] Sign In Deferred After Pet Selection Reorder: Move sign_in to occur after pet friend selection and photo upload, letting users select their companion first.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "sign_in", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
9: [adoption, hint] Pick Friend Character Trait Comparison Hint: Add clear hint text describing how different pets behave on the desktop during selection.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"hint": "Each pet has unique desktop behavior: playful pets explore your desktop while calm pets stay cozy near the tray."}}
